verses.text: Ab'ek hex b'eyum. Elokab' wek'ek'ok heyaw heyok'i, yujto ay niwak yahelal wan sjawi t'a heyib'anh.
Ha he b'eyumal chi' k'a'eltakxo, haxo he pichul, toxonhej b'ulanek'i, olchimtakxo yuj nok' nok'.

Icha pax chi' k'e'en he tumin, chik'takxo k'e'en. Scheklajel he mul yuj schik'il k'e'en he tumin chi'. Icha stz'a junok tas yuj k'ak', icha chi' ol aj slajwi'el he niwanil yuj schik'il k'e'en. Te niwan he b'eyumal chi' tze molb'ej, palta ina wanxo sja slajwub' k'uhal.
Ha heb' he majan smunlaj t'ayex max he tuplaj heb', tonhej tzeyak' musansatil heb'. Yuj chi' tz'awajcha'anh heb' t'a he patik yalan he mul, haxo yaw heb' chi' syab' Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil.

Ha hex tik wach' tzex ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, b'ut'an yol he pat yuj masanil tastak ay t'ayex. Toxonhej tz'ixtax heyu'uj. Icha junok wakax tz'ak'ji serwil yik b'ak'echxo ayik smilchaji, ich hex ta'. Tonhej tzeyak' jab'ok he gana.
Ha hex tzeyak'b'at t'a yib'anh heb' tojol spensar. Ay pax heb' tze milchamok. Palta max spak sb'a heb' t'ayex.

Niwan tzeyutej he k'o'ol he tanhwan sja'ub'al Kajal. Ina heb' munlajwum stanhwan yelul sat smunlajel, haton jun sat te nib'ab'il. Stanhwej heb' yem b'ab'el nhab', stanhwej pax heb' slajwi'ek' nhab'il k 'inal, palta niwannhej syutej sk'o'ol heb' yet' smunlajel chi'.
Icha syutej sb'a heb' munlajwum chi', icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a he tanhwan sjax Kajalil. Tek'tek' tzeyutej he b'a, yujto toxo ol jaxok.
Manh heyeklaj he patikok junjun hex, yik manh ol ak'jokoch t'a heyib'anh, yujto toxo ol ja jun ol honh ch'olb'itanok.
Hex wuktak hex wanab', ha heb' schekab' Dios alannak el slolonel Dios chi' t'a peka', techajnak yuj heb' yab'an sya'il. Niwan yutejnakpax sk'o'ol heb'. Yuj chi' b'eyb'alejek sb'eyb'al heb' chi'.

Kojtak to ha heb' ak'annak techaj chi', tzalajk'olal yaj heb' tikne'ik. Na'ekkot yab'ixal winhaj Job. Tek'an yutejnak sb'a winh yab'an syahelal. Na'ekpaxkoti, chajtil ajnak winh yuj Kajalil t'a slajwub'alxo, yujto ok'nak sk'o'ol t'a winh, ochnak pax pitz'an t'a sk'o'ol Kajalil chi' yuj winh.

Palta ay wal junxo ol wal t'ayex to yowalil tze wach' k'anab'ajej. Manh he komon lokej sb'i Dios ay t'a satcha'anh, ma sb'i junokxo mach, ma sb'i junokxo tas ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Icha'okab' tik tzeyutej he loloni. Tato yel, Yel, xe chinhej. Tato ma'ay, Maay, xe chinhej, yik manh ol kotkan t'a heyib'anh.
Tato ayex wan heyab'an sya'il tikne'ik, lesalwanhek. Tato ayex ay he tzalajk'olal jun, b'itananhek t'a Dios.
Tato ayex pena'ay hex, awtejek heb' anciano yik iglesia. Ha hexxo anciano hex, lesalwanhek yuj heb'. Tze sukanek' aceite t'a heb' t'a sb'i Kajal.

Tato tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'o'ol ayik tzex lesalwi yuj heb', ol kolchajel heb' t'a syahelal chi'. Haxo Kajalil ol ak'an b'oxok sk'o'ol heb'. Tato ix och smul heb' jun, ol ak'jok lajwok smul heb' chi' yuj Dios.
Yuj chi', al-lajek k'eta he mul t'ayex junjun hex. Tzex lesalwi heyu'uj junjun hex, yik wach' ol b'oxok he k'o'ol. Ha slesal heb' tojol spensar, tzijtum wal tas sb'o yuj.
Ayik yek'nak winhaj Elías t'a peka', anima winh icha honh tik. Lesalwinak winh t'a smasanil sk'o'ol yik max yak' nhab'. Nanhal schanhil ab'il majxo yak'laj nhab' t'a jun lugar chi'.
Hato yik slesalwinakxi winh, ichato chi' yak'anxi nhab'. Ichato chi' syaxb'inakxi sat lum lum.
Tato ay mach t'a he kal syik'el sb'a t'a slolonel Dios te yel, komonok ayex junok hex tzeyek sna'a yik wach' syak'xi'och sb'a t'ay.
Nachajokab'el jun tik heyu'uj. Ha junok mach tz'ekan sna'a yik syaktejkan schukal, wan skolanelta t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Yuj chi' ol lajwok jantak smul chi'.
